name: Ceasair

attributes.attribute: the leader figure whose name Ceasair spells

text: Ceasair is a variant spelling of Cesair. MacKillop lists it beside Cessair, Cesara, and Kesair. All name the leader figure of the first settling of Ireland.

okr.objective: Record Ceasair as a variant spelling routed to the Cesair entry.
key_results: The spelling Ceasair is tied to Cesair.
Cesair is the leader figure of the first settling of Ireland.
MacKillop 2008 lists the spelling set Cessair, Cesara, Kesair, Ceasair.
